S-13.decidedBy: Kyle, 14 Nov 2026: the Corvette costs 26,000 CR (World Atlas, Ships); Kyle, 27 Nov 2026: warships carry more cargo, one high (World Atlas, Ships)
works: Cargo: 7 × 20 ft containers, one high so every gun fires clear over them: 4 across behind the bridge and 3 on the stern deck. Plus 2 pallets on deck. A crane at the berth lifts cargo on and off from above; nothing rolls on.
Below deck: stores hold, 30 units. A deck hatch opens onto it and the crane works straight down through the hatch.

Loot: sunk pirates leave pallets floating, each with a random load. A net boom on each side swings out over the water and scoops a pallet up as she drives past. It lands on one of her 2 pallet places, so a full deck takes no more. She has no magnet, so she cannot lift scrap.
Fighting: 9 weapon mounts (4 small, 3 medium, 2 large). The player buys and fits the guns; each one trains and fires on its own pad.
Handling: 38 m/s top speed, 1100 hull points.
S-13.quote: All-round warship: a strong hull, two large guns, seven containers and a stores hold.

S-00.name: Rust bucket
S-00.decidedBy: Kyle, 17 Nov 2026: the starter is the Rust bucket, her own model. In both games since 18 Nov 2026 (Runners PR #75; Lite has the same model). Kyle, 25 Nov 2026: give her her own card, since every player starts in her. Kyle, 25 Nov 2026 (World Atlas, Storage): "The starter Rust bucket carries one container plus her three pallet places (was three pallets only)". Kyle, 26 Nov 2026: the container-deck model is approved (containers on deck with hatch covers and twistlocks, no cage frames; every ship carries at least 1 container, 8 pallets = 1 container). Numbers from the World Atlas, Runners 2055 - Ships (final numbers as built, 26 Nov 2026). Kyle, 26 Nov 2026, on the pictures: "On the website make sure we show the models fully loaded instead of empty."
S-00.quote: The boat every player starts in: a Scrapper that was due for the scrapyard. Booker gives the Runner a boat nobody wanted.
S-00.look: The Scrapper run down: bent rails, the wheelhouse roof rusted through, the windows boarded up, and rust streaks and patched plating from bow to stern.
works: Starter: every player begins in her, free. Every first ship of the other lines is traded up from her.
Refit: at ARI's yard she can be traded in and rebuilt as a clean Scrapper for 500 CR.
Cargo: 1 × 20 ft container on marked deck spots and 3 pallets on deck. A crane at the berth lifts cargo on and off from above; nothing rolls on.
Scrap: her deck crane swings its magnet out over the side, lifts scrap from the water and drops it in the open bin on deck. Holds 8 units.
Loot: sunk pirates leave pallets floating, each with a random load. Her magnet crane lifts a pallet aboard onto one of her 3 pallet places, so a full deck takes no more.
Towing: none. She has no winch.
Fighting: 1 weapon mount (1 small). The player buys and fits the guns; each one trains and fires on its own pad.
Handling: 45 m/s top speed, 90 hull points. Her plating is rotten through in places, so she is a little slower and weaker than a clean Scrapper (48 m/s, 100).
S-00.atlas: Starter: the player's Scrapper is the **Rust bucket**, her own model: the approved Scrapper made into a boat that was due for the scrapyard: bent rails, roof rusted through, windows boarded up. Booker gives the Runner a boat nobody wanted. The clean Scrapper is the one you can buy. Because she's in bad shape the Rust bucket is slightly slower and weaker: 45 m/s and 90 hull points (clean Scrapper 48 m/s, 100).

works: Cargo: 6 × 20 ft containers, one high in the well deck, and 6 pallets on deck. A crane at the berth lifts cargo on and off from above; nothing rolls on.

Fighting: 3 weapon mounts (3 small). The player buys and fits the guns; each one trains and fires on its own pad.

S-02.quote: Small, fast and plain. One container and two pallets of honest cargo on deck, and a small hidden compartment for four more pallets under the box.
works: Smuggling: 4 pallets ride in the hidden hold in her hull. Her one container stands over the whole hold: a crane lifts the box off, a disguised hatch in the deck opens, and the hidden pallets go straight down. Shut, nothing shows. High income, high risk.
Honest cargo, in plain sight: 1 × 20 ft container (8 pallets) and 2 pallets on deck. That is 10 pallets of honest cargo against 4 hidden. Loaded by crane.

Loot: sunk pirates leave pallets floating, each with a random load. A net boom on each side swings out over the water and scoops a pallet up as she drives past. It lands on one of her 2 pallet places, so a full deck takes no more. She has no magnet, so she cannot lift scrap.
Fighting: 1 weapon mount (1 small). The player buys and fits the guns; each one trains and fires on its own pad.
Handling: 54 m/s top speed, 90 hull points.
features: Hidden compartment: a hatch set flush in the deck, made to look like ordinary deck plating, over a small hold for 4 pallets, 2 by 2. Her container stands on top of it.
With the box in place nothing shows: she looks like a launch carrying one container and two pallets.
Everything smuggled is pallets, hidden in the hull. No smuggled goods ride in a container or in sight.
The hidden hold is a real, hollow space in the hull, with clear sky over its opening so a crane can lower pallets in and lift them out.
The way in is hidden and animated. When it is shut, nothing on deck gives it away: no handles, hinges or seams that an ordinary ship would not have.
